filum.digitalizza.a_light_foundation_lay: A light foundation layer under each fill
filum.digitalizza.a_line_along_every_edg: A line along every edge between contrasting colours.
filum.digitalizza.a_line_continues_throu: A line continues through a junction when it bends less than this — fewer, longer lines (0: every junction ends the lines)
filum.digitalizza.a_quilted_random_walk_: A quilted random walk — light, few stitches
filum.digitalizza.a_running_stitch_along: A running stitch along the outlines
filum.digitalizza.a_spiral_around_the_ce: A spiral around the centre (Ink/Stitch circular fill)
filum.digitalizza.add_the_shapes_and_kee: Add the shapes and keep the stitched objects (Ink/Stitch keep original)

filum.digitalizza.always_a_fill_never_li: Always a fill — never lines, also not as ink
filum.digitalizza.always_lines_along_the: Always lines along the centre (outlines, details), whatever their width
filum.digitalizza.an_outline_around_the_: An outline around the whole design (patches, stickers)
filum.digitalizza.as_you_hoop_real_desig: as you hoop real designs, the letters upright
filum.digitalizza.at_right_angles_to_the: At right angles to the thread

filum.digitalizza.click_to_add_alt_or: Click to add · Alt- or right-click to exclude a part.
filum.digitalizza.clipboard_access_was_d: Clipboard access was denied — press Ctrl+V instead

filum.digitalizza.colours_appear_here_af: Colours appear here after loading an image.
filum.digitalizza.copies_of_name_in_a: Copies of “{name}” in a grid, one setting stepped from copy to copy and named after its value — sew them once and keep the best.
filum.digitalizza.custom_settings_pick_a: Custom settings — pick a preset to start from
filum.digitalizza.dark_lines_found_on_th: Dark lines found on the picture itself, even where the colour reduction merged them into a neighbour (0 = off)
filum.digitalizza.dark_lines_outlines_in: Dark lines (outlines, ink) as satin of one even width — 0: as wide as drawn
filum.digitalizza.decided_from_the_pictu: Decided from the picture: thin, long shapes and ink become lines, the rest fills

filum.digitalizza.distance_between_the_r: Distance between the rows — wider: lighter, more graphic
filum.digitalizza.drop_paste_or_choose_a: Drop, paste or choose an image

filum.digitalizza.every_dark_line_become: Every dark line becomes a satin of this width (below 1 mm: a triple running stitch)
filum.digitalizza.field_cells_across_eac: Field cells across each shape — more follow smaller features, fewer give long sweeping rows
filum.digitalizza.fill_stitch_a_fill_kee: Fill stitch (a fill keeps its settings)

filum.digitalizza.how_much_of_a_cell: How much of a cell must be stitched to get a cross
filum.digitalizza.how_much_of_a_cell_2: How much of a cell must be inside a shape to get a cross
filum.digitalizza.how_much_rows_follow_t: How much rows follow the picture (100 %) instead of the base direction (0 %)

filum.digitalizza.ink_stitch_s_defaults_: Ink/Stitch's defaults: only closed loops of stitches make shapes (outlines, running stitch)
filum.digitalizza.it_uses_this_design_s: It uses this design's thread weight and machine settings. Take it out of the hoop and let it rest a minute before you measure.
filum.digitalizza.its_own_objects_even_w: Its own objects, even where colours continue outside
filum.digitalizza.join_line_ends_that_po: Join line ends that point at each other (or at another line) across a gap up to this size
filum.digitalizza.label_is_back_to_the: {label} is back to the standard numbers
filum.digitalizza.learned_edges_dexined_: Learned edges (DexiNed, on-device): both sides of strong edges — shown on the Original tab.
filum.digitalizza.leave_out_shapes_and_h: Leave out shapes and holes smaller than this area (Ink/Stitch threshold)
filum.digitalizza.leave_out_the_colour_t: Leave out the colour that dominates the image border
filum.digitalizza.light_fills_and_wide_r: Light fills and wide rows (up to 1.2 mm apart)
filum.digitalizza.line_centres_follow_th: Line centres follow the drawn line (its darkness profile), not the pixel grid — thin, smoothed lines stay straight and smooth
filum.digitalizza.lines_narrower_than_th: Lines narrower than the hairline width
Lines narrower than the hairline width are running stitch, wider ones satin.
filum.digitalizza.lines_of_the_picture_n: Lines of the picture: none, as wide as drawn, or one even satin width (clean logo outlines, sewn as one network; below 1 mm a triple running stitch)
filum.digitalizza.lines_show_which_way_t: Lines show which way the stitches run.

filum.digitalizza.lines_up_to_this_width: Lines up to this width become stitched lines; wider shapes stay fills
filum.digitalizza.lower_strength_straigh: Lower strength straightens the rows towards the base direction.
filum.digitalizza.merge_colours_closer_t: Merge colours closer than this (CIEDE2000; 0 = off)
filum.digitalizza.merge_into_the_nearest: Merge into the nearest remaining colour
filum.digitalizza.merges_the_rows_of_fil: Merges the rows of fills and satins (rows up to 0.6 mm apart) into solid shapes
filum.digitalizza.mobilesam_click_an_obj: MobileSAM: click an object in the picture, then decide what happens to it.
filum.digitalizza.more_lines_and_fainter: More lines, and fainter ones, with higher values
filum.digitalizza.narrow_elongated_regio: Narrow, elongated regions become satin columns along their medial axis
filum.digitalizza.neighbouring_shapes_sh: Neighbouring shapes share one traced boundary (no gaps, no overlaps); corners stay sharp, pixel steps become smooth curves
filum.digitalizza.never_stitch_this_leav: Never stitch this — leaves a gap
filum.digitalizza.not_measured_these_kee: Not measured: these keep their current numbers.
filum.digitalizza.nothing_to_stitch_ever: Nothing to stitch — every colour is left out.

filum.digitalizza.objects_gave_none.othe: · {n} objects gave none — try a larger buffer
filum.digitalizza.on_this_device_new_sat: on this device. New satins and fills on

filum.digitalizza.one_continuous_spiral_: One continuous spiral from the outline inwards
filum.digitalizza.one_cross_per_cell_the: One cross per cell; the cells line up with the canvas grid, so crosses of different colours meet exactly.
filum.digitalizza.one_line_per_place_the: One line per place: the lines in the picture come first, then the border, then these.
filum.digitalizza.only_edges_between_col: Only edges between colours at least this different (CIEDE2000) — higher: fewer lines
filum.digitalizza.only_the_lines_found_i: Only the lines found in the picture itself (Lines in the picture).
filum.digitalizza.outlines_ink_strokes_a: Outlines, ink strokes and narrow shapes become stitched lines along their centre — through junctions, small gaps bridged — and the fills continue under them, so nothing gapes.
filum.digitalizza.output_preset_the_look: Output, preset, the look and the size
filum.digitalizza.parallel_staggered_row: Parallel staggered rows — the classic, even fill
filum.digitalizza.parts_lighter_than_thi: Parts lighter than this stay empty (the fabric shows)
filum.digitalizza.pick_a_colour_on_the: Pick a colour on the picture as
filum.digitalizza.pictures_become_cross_: Pictures become cross stitch in the digitizer
filum.digitalizza.png_jpg_webp_bmp_or: PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP or GIF — logos and flat artwork work best
filum.digitalizza.rays_from_the_centre_o: Rays from the centre of each shape
filum.digitalizza.remove_it_and_fill_the: Remove it and fill the area from its surroundings
filum.digitalizza.replace_the_outlines_b: Replace the outlines by the grid cells they cover — what will be sewn, editable as shapes (Ink/Stitch pixelize)
filum.digitalizza.rings_that_follow_the_: Rings that follow the outline of each shape

filum.digitalizza.rows_follow_the_outlin: Rows follow the outline of each shape
filum.digitalizza.rows_run_along_the_lon: Rows run along the long axis of each shape
filum.digitalizza.satin_edge_a_satin_in: Satin edge — a satin in this colour's thread where its shapes meet the background (as wide as the border's satin)
filum.digitalizza.satin_lines_get_wider_: Satin lines get wider and narrower like the drawn line
filum.digitalizza.satin_strokes_line_art: Satin strokes, line art and outlines
filum.digitalizza.satin_width_the_border: Satin width (the border uses it too)
filum.digitalizza.scattered_points_joine: Scattered points joined into one sketchy line
filum.digitalizza.select_a_running_stitc: Select a running stitch, satin or fill to make swatches of.
filum.digitalizza.select_fill_shapes_to_: Select fill shapes to stitch as crosses — or make cross stitch from a picture in the digitizer.

filum.digitalizza.smaller_specks_merge_i: Smaller specks merge into their neighbour
filum.digitalizza.smooth_colour_ramps_be: Smooth colour ramps become dithered gradient fills instead of bands
filum.digitalizza.smoothing_passes_of_th: Smoothing passes of the picture's edge flow — more give calmer curves
filum.digitalizza.start_from_these_numbe: start from these numbers; you can still change them per object.

filum.digitalizza.tesseract_ticked_lines: Tesseract: ticked lines are erased from the picture and added as real lettering.
filum.digitalizza.the_background_colour_: The background colour: left out around the design and in plain holes (letter counters), left out only around it (every enclosed area stitched: a logo's white faces), or stitched everywhere
filum.digitalizza.the_border_colour_is_l: The border colour is left out where it reaches the edge of the picture, and in plain holes (letter counters, the inside of rings and outlines). Small enclosed areas (highlights) and ones with shapes on them (a badge face) are stitched.
The border colour is left out only where it reaches the edge of the picture: every area enclosed by the design is stitched (a logo's white faces inside its outlines).
The border colour is left out everywhere, also inside shapes (letter counters, holes).
